entries.subject: DAMIT 301: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-301.txt. Model 301, version 2011-02-18, pole (294°, 41°), period 7.87754 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 58 ±16 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.
